limits.en: Fully free and open-source (GNU GPL-v3), no feature restrictions.

keyLimits.en: Complete rigging and animation toolkit, no paywall for core features.

addOns.en: Optional paid User Guide, 39 EUR one-time.
Optional video courses on a name-your-own-price model.

capabilities.en: Character, prop and camera rigging toolkit for After Effects, described as the industry-standard rigging tool.
Automation features for common animation tasks: wiggle, random motion, wheel, spring, bounce, looper, swing, blink, and walk/run cycles.
Keyframe and interpolation management tools, plus camera controls and scripting/expression utilities.

limitations.en: Works only inside Adobe After Effects; not a standalone application.
Requires learning a rigging-specific workflow; official paid guide and video courses exist because the learning curve is non-trivial.

reason.en: Existing catalogue alternative, another After Effects rigging tool with a simpler limb-rigging focus.
Existing catalogue alternative, bone/rigging plugin for After Effects.
Existing catalogue alternative, After Effects rigging and animation plugin.

unknowns: Exact current version number and release cadence beyond what was shown (v17.1.21, with an alpha pre-release for members) may have changed since access.
